patterns.what_worked: The repo's own history held the post-HU-23 library: git log -S found 29f1731, whose file is the full patch. Using it as a reference implementation rather than copying it preserved the 2026-10-25 upstream changes while restoring every guard the tests pin. Reading Blizzard's origin/forever SwingTimer end to end turned TASK B from guesswork into a per-arm comparison and exposed one real defect (a weapon swap rescaled the live cycle instead of restarting it, unlike both Blizzard's bar and the classic lib).
patterns.what_was_hard: The patched library had a different internal architecture from the 2026-10-25 upstream base (minRangeCheck vs findMinRangeChecker), so the guards had to be re-expressed, not pasted; the min-range checker had to stay in the list even when no fallback exists or the hybrid profile loses its band. The mutation runner also needed CRLF-aware matching for the vendored file.
